content:
Hello!
I am thinking about using Veil to model a Byzantine-tolerant protocol.
I wanted to ask you about liveness properties. I noticed in your website that liveness properties are left for the future. What do you mean by that? That the framework does not provide any automatic-reasoning tool? Or that effectively writing liveness properties is hard?
Do you have any experience (like tutorials, examples) on writing liveness properties in Veil?
[ thanks in advance :muscle: ]

Hi! Currently, we don't have built-in support for verifying liveness properties in Veil. So far, our work has mainly focused on safety properties. While it is possible to encode certain liveness-style properties manually, there isn't yet a well-supported way to do so, and we don't have dedicated tooling or tutorials for it.

That said, we have started exploring this direction and have some preliminary support (e.g., a small LTL library), though it is still quite early.
